title: dryopteris patentissima
intro: Dryopteris patentissima, commonly known as the Japanese shield fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris patentissima include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and supporting the immune system, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential applications of this plant in modern medicine.
